the_risk: A branch cut from 2026-07-27 predates the entire outcome-label control layer AND the 8/8 data corrections. If it is merged naively — especially anything touching data/backfill/mlb/2026/results.csv, harness/healthcheck.py or the registry — it can (a) reintroduce results.csv WITHOUT the provenance columns, silently voiding the FINAL/PROVISIONAL gate, (b) restore the three reversed 8/8 winners, and (c) bypass the registration-required-to-grade check. 'Keeping later MLB work untouched' is the right intent, but intent is not a merge strategy.
required_before_merge: Rebase the NFL work onto current HEAD (2b64e68 or later) rather than merging a July-27 base.
The NFL track must add ONLY files under data/nfl/** and an nfl_* harness namespace — zero edits to results.csv, healthcheck.py, forecast_registry.py, model_registry.py or any MLB artifact.
Register any NFL model as a NEW model_id in harness/model_registry.py; it may not reuse or extend a V13/V14 identity (V13 is FROZEN as of 2026-08-10).
harness/healthcheck.py must pass at 0 fail after integration, including the provenance, content-check and registration gates.
NFL prices stay quarantined from features, matching the MLB rule: forecast first, price second.
agreement_with_the_narrative: Storing quotes as a timestamped evaluation board and never as predictive features — correct, and matches how the WNBA board is handled.
Preserving the pasted timestamp verbatim while registering the corrected kickoff, with the mismatch flagged rather than silently fixed — correct, and implemented here.
Freezing estimator/features/split/deadbands/gates before fitting — correct, and matches the V14 shadow pre-registration.
correction_to_the_narrative: The timestamp defect is not only a clock-label error. The uniform -4h shift also moves FOUR games to the previous day (LAC@HOU, ARI@LV, TEN@SF from Fri 8/14 to Thu 8/13; DAL@SEA from Sun 8/16 to Sat 8/15). Registering kickoff from the official schedule fixes the time but a slate registered under the board's DATE HEADERS would still group those four games on the wrong day.
second_defect_the_narrative_did_not_repo: Caesars posts the opposite favourite from the other three books on at least five games (LAC@HOU, TB@NYJ, MIA@WAS, CAR@BUF, JAX@NO). Any cross-book consensus must resolve or exclude these before averaging.
